variants.headline: Still in view: builder signs for a new project
variants.sub: A construction contract for {project} has been awarded to {builder}.
variants.body:
The builder {builder} has signed a contract for {project}. Coverage of this story continues; the original event remains the starting point for the questions examined here.

The gazette records the builder, the project and the price as the terms established by the award. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.
